references.text: Describes the southern border of the land of Canaan from the Salt Sea (Dead Sea), the same geographical reference point as in Joshua 15:2
Mentions the Salt Sea as a boundary marker for the tribe of Benjamin, the same geographical area
Refers to the Salt Sea as the eastern border of the promised land
Continues the description of Judah's eastern border at the Salt Sea to the Jordan River
Mentions the Valley of Salt as a geographical area near the Salt Sea
Refers to the Salt Sea (Sea of Arabah) as a geographical reference point
